key_idea: Constructing a stationary reversible Markov chain whose edge labels track a free group action via order-preserving homeomorphisms of the reals, forcing deterministic linear drift in a spreading norm.
reason: The proof brilliantly combines Banach space geometry with dynamical systems, using free group actions to engineer a reversible random walk with macroscopic linear displacement. Its modular structure and profound conceptual clarity make a deep and historically difficult result feel surprisingly natural and inevitable.
